controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Cassini I/F observations projected onto the released shape. Bounded photometric normalization reduces broad acquired shading; true cast shadows and unreliable geometry are withheld. Gray grid marks unobserved areas.
controls.title: Cassini I/F observations projected onto the released shape. Bounded photometric normalization reduces broad acquired shading; true cast shadows and unreliable geometry are withheld. Gray grid marks unobserved areas.
controls.summary: Cassini images mapped onto the shape. Shadows and unreliable samples are withheld; gray grid marks gaps.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Radial height above a 14 km reference sphere from the Cassini shape model. This includes the broad irregular shape; it is not height above a gravity-defined geoid. Fixed relief lighting shows slopes; shape uncertainties vary by region.
